title: Error Handling, Retries, Rollbacks & Escalation
summary: Select and configure agent tools, set up MCP servers with registries and allow lists, integrate agents into CI, and implement safe execution with robust error handling.

items: **Error handling:** Catch tool call failures; distinguish transient vs permanent errors
**Retries:** Use exponential backoff for transient failures; MUST be idempotent
**Rollbacks:** Revert branch changes; restore prior state using git revert patterns
**Escalation:** When automated recovery fails → notify human reviewer → halt execution
**Traceability:** Every action linked to: instruction (why) → tool call (how) → output (what)

blocks.text: **Idempotency Rule:** If a tool call might be retried, it MUST be idempotent — calling it twice produces the same result without duplicating side-effects (no duplicate tickets, no double commits).
